_comment: Scenarios for `pnpm scenarios` (real model, in-memory repo, never in CI). A turn is an employee message, or a representative action between turns: { rep: { kind?, field?, typed? | text? } }. The invariants (src/testing/invariants.ts) are checked after every employee turn. Fictional data only.
